insanity.line: And counseled all my clients to plead insanity
stanza: Of course, I went to law school and took a law degree
And counseled all my clients to plead insanity
Then worked in hair replacement swindling the bald
Where very few are chosen and fewer still are called

stanza: I met a friend of spirit

He saw my complications
And he mirrored me back simplified

"Heart and humor and humility"

sanity.line: How would you say you managed to keep a level of sanity?
sanity.linePrev: And through your different avenues of success
sanity.lineNext: By my faith in God, by my faith in the game
